title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
A SNAPSHOT OF CURVION

Curvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients.

Think of a lead generation based marketing agency... but focused on sales.

We design and install complete sales systems from sales processes and GTM strategy to CRM setup, all the way to fully outsourced sales engagements. Then we put AI-enabled tools, battle-tested playbooks, and trained sales talent behind those systems to help our clients generate revenue faster, operate more efficiently, and scale with greater consistency, clarity, and control.

Put simply, we build the infrastructure and systems that make sales work better.

POSITION OVERVIEW

What the heck is a Data & Analytics Engineer, right?!

Think of it as the architect, builder, and strategist of our sales data universe, all rolled into one.

This role is the nerve center of Curvion’s reporting ecosystem, making sure every number, metric, and trend we rely on is accurate, trustworthy, and actionable.

You’ll build and optimize data infrastructure in BigQuery, fine-tune ETL/ELT processes, design dashboards in Looker Studio, and ensure our sales leaders have clear, reliable data to guide decisions.

In short, you’re the person who makes the data magic happen so our teams can operate smarter, close more deals, and scale faster.

If you love clean data, efficient workflows, solving complex data problems, and turning raw numbers into actionable insights, you’re going to thrive here.

YOU SHOULD APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- You’re fluent in SQL and genuinely enjoy query optimization

- You have strong Python skills and understand how to use it to solve real data problems

- You love taking messy, scattered data and making it reliable and usable

- You can build dashboards that make complex information easy for sales leaders to understand

- You enjoy building pipelines and workflows that work reliably and efficiently

- You can spot a reporting anomaly from a mile away

- You’re obsessed with accuracy, data integrity, and efficiency

- You naturally investigate the root cause when something doesn’t look right

- You get fired up about eliminating manual reporting processes

- You want to directly impact revenue without having to jump on sales calls

- You’re comfortable working independently while still collaborating closely with a high-energy team

- You believe sales data should drive decisions, not just look pretty

YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- Complex SQL queries or data warehouses make you want to run for the hills

- You get bored managing and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines

- You think “good enough” is an acceptable standard for reporting accuracy

- You don’t enjoy solving data puzzles or tracking down inconsistencies

- You’re resistant to learning new tools, systems, or automation methods

- You’d rather eyeball data than thoroughly audit it

- You’re not interested in supporting a high-performance sales environment

- You prefer slow-paced environments with minimal change

- You think dashboards are a “nice to have” instead of a critical business tool

- You still believe spreadsheets should be the primary reporting system

- You eat your pizza with ranch... may be flexible on this one

GENERAL EXPECTED DUTIES:

- Design, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure accurate and timely data flow into BigQuery

- Monitor, audit, and troubleshoot datasets to maintain accuracy, consistency, and completeness

- Build, maintain, and improve Looker Studio dashboards and reporting

- Optimize reporting performan

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $8-$10 per hour

Schedule:

- Monday to Friday

- 9AM-6PM, PST (Must be available to work US hours)

Work Location: Remote

description:

Nemours Radiology is one of the largest pediatric radiology groups in the United States, comprised of more than 50 pediatric radiologists working together to provide state-of-the-art diagnostic and interventional radiology services at our locations in Delaware, Florida, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Over the past year, approximately 500,000 imaging examinations were performed across the system. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. • Follow established protocols and processes, with an eye towards improving operational processes to provide the best patient experience.

• Licensed RN - must hold a compact state license or live in an eligible state

• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adhere to deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and quality

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, frequently changing environment 

• Creative problem-solving skills with a results-driven mindset

• Can quickly learn new technology systems and communication tools

• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively

• 3+ year(s) experience working with physicians and/or patients in a healthcare setting preferred, ideally

Lumanity is dedicated to improving patient health by accelerating and optimizing access to medical advances. We partner with life sciences companies around the world to generate evidence to demonstrate the value of their product, translate the science and data into compelling product narratives, and enable commercial decisions that position these products for success in the market. We do this through strategic and complimentary areas of focus: Asset Optimization and Commercialization, Value Access and Outcomes, Medical Strategy and Communications, and Real-World Evidence.
Responsibilities / Position overview
We are seeking a seasoned Statistician with a background in Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR)/Health Technology Assessment (HTA) to join our HEOR Research team. In this senior level role, the statistician will play a key and influential role and contribute to the growth and evolution of the team.
Key responsibilities will include, but not be limited to: leading statistical input and providing expert guidance to projects, developing statistical analysis plans, performing and reporting statistical analysis as standalone research or for input into health economic models that will provide direct information to clients, and governing/reimbursement bodies and/or for publication. Common types of analyses/projects performed include, but are not restricted to:
· Survival analyses:
o Parametric survival analyses
o Adjustments from treatment switch/cross-over within clinical trials
· Indirect treatment comparisons
o Network meta-analyses
o Population-adjusted indirect comparisons (e.g. matching-adjusted indirect comparisons)
o Time-varying indirect treatment comparisons (e.g. fractional polynomials)
· Analyses of clinical trial data (e.g. quality of life)
· Analyses of observational data/real world evidence
· Statistical input into reimbursement submissions to health technology agencies
The successful candidate should be motivated to learn and apply new methodologies and techniques in the evolving field of HTA and reimbursement.
Close collaboration, both within the Statistics team, wider Research team and cross- functionally with the HEOR Consulting team, is an essential part of the role. Furthermore, this role is external-facing, and you will be required to demonstrate professional excellence in client and other external stakeholder interactions.
The role can be tailored to an individual candidate’s strengths and aspirations, but will include a mix of roles and responsibilities, including strategic input and oversight of statistical content on projects, collaboration internally and externally with experts in specific fields, programming, writing (planning, reporting, manuscripts and submission documents), quality control, mentoring, training, line management, and for the suitable candidate, there are research and development opportunities.
This opportunity offers flexible work setting options to suit individual needs. This can be fully remote with options to work in any of our offices as needed, if preferred.

title: Talent Acquisition Associate (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena (finanziert von Google Ventures) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir übernehmen deutschlandweit Hausverwaltungen und verwandeln diese in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern in Berlin zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d), um unseren Wettbewerbsvorteil im M&A-Bereich weiter auszubauen.

Wenn wir Immobilienverwaltungsunternehmen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen, ist es entscheidend, in kurzer Zeit Mitarbeiter in unseren Unternehmen einzusetzen, die technologieaffin & lernbereit sind und den klassischen Job des Immobilienverwalters neu definieren möchten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Talente für uns zu gewinnen.

Arbeiten bei Buena bedeutet "Volle Verantwortung" ab Tag eins. Du übernimmst von Beginn an Verantwortung für ein Portfolio von über 500 Mitarbeitern und baust proaktiv “Talentpools” deutschlandweit auf. So stellst du sicher, dass jede neue Verwaltung im Portfolio zu jeder Zeit mit den besten Mitarbeitern ausgestattet ist.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer zweiten Führungsebene im HQ, den lokalen Geschäftsführern vor Ort und unserem HQ Talent Team zusammen.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Recruiting ist ein zentraler Teil unserer Unternehmensstrategie, daher erwarten wir eine stark technologie-unterstützte Arbeitsweise, Outputorientierung und Professionalität im Umgang mit den Talenten.

- 80% deiner ersten Monate verbringst du im Sourcing von Talenten via unserer verschiedener Kanäle. Du übernimmst auch erste Screening Gespräche.

- Du baust, optimierst und verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting Prozess End-to-End, und implementiert ein CRM, das Effizienz gewährleistet.

- Du verknüpfst die M&A-Pipeline nahtlos mit der Talent-Pipeline.

- Du screenst den deutschen Markt systematisch und baust strategische Talentpools für zukünftige Targets auf.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Vor Ort in unserem HQ in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

- 1-3 Jahre messbare Erfolge im Recruiting oder Headhunting mitbringst und nachweislich Rollen erfolgreich besetzt hast.

- Eine hohe Resilienz in der Direktansprache besitzt, souverän agierst und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest.

- Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in den Bereichen Methodik und Technologie-unterstützten Arbeiten möchtest. Du solltest AI sinnvoll nutzen können und andere Sourcing Tools kennen.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit ~25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf: Die Wohneigentumsquote in Deutschland liegt weit unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Buena wird das ändern.

Projetos e rituais: Liderar iniciativas de Gente de ponta a ponta, desde a estruturação do problema até a entrega do resultado, incluindo projetos transversais. description:
Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead
Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.) | Federal Civilian Practice
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
A 20-year-old federal platform sits behind a home loan benefit that millions of American families depend on. Your job is to help retire it without anyone noticing.
You will own the DevSecOps and platform engineering ecosystem for a modernization program that runs legacy and modern stacks side by side: pipelines that move code from commit to production in under an hour, zero-downtime production deployments, environments built and torn down as code, and observability deep enough to explain a failure before the customer reports it. You will do this inside real federal security constraints, with real authority over how the engineering system works, and with AI as a first-class engineering tool.
The Opportunity
Most DevSecOps roles hand you an inherited pipeline and a backlog of tickets. This one hands you an engineering system to shape.
The program spans multiple applications, technology stacks, and platforms: a legacy suite that must stay stable and secure until it is decommissioned, and a modern cloud platform (Salesforce-centered, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) where new capability lands every month. Production runs 24/7 against contractual availability targets. Releases ship to production at least monthly. Critical vulnerabilities must close in 30 days. The monitoring bar is full business transaction visibility, not “the server is up.”
You will lead the engineers who make all of that true. Not from a status meeting. From the architecture, the pipeline definitions, the incident bridge, and the customer conversation. You will decide how code moves from a developer's hands to production, how failures get detected and diagnosed, how security gets enforced without slowing delivery, and where automation and AI replace manual work.
The outcomes are measured, visible, and attached to a mission that matters. When deployments get faster and incidents get rarer, the customer sees it, and so do the people the program serves.
A note on the stack. If “Salesforce” made you hesitate, read this twice. You will not become a Salesforce administrator, and this role will not narrow your career. The application platform is Salesforce. The engineering system around it is not. The CI/CD architecture, environment automation, serverless cloud components, observability, security automation, legacy systems, and AI-enabled workflows are general-purpose platform engineering, and that is where you will spend your time. A strong platform engineer picks up the Salesforce-specific pieces quickly. The reverse is not true, which is why we are hiring for the former.
What You'll Own

• The delivery platform. Design and run CI/CD that lets teams move code from commit to production across multiple applications, stacks, and environments with minimal manual intervention. The standard: builds, tests, and deployments complete in under an hour, and production releases ship monthly or faster.

• Zero-downtime release engineering. Build deployment automation that verifies a release in production before users touch it, and rolls back cleanly when verification fails. Boring deployments are the goal.

• Environments as code. Automate provisioning so a complete environment stands up or tears down in days, not months, and configuration drift stops being a source of incidents.

• Security engineered into the pipeline. Make quality and security gates automatic, surface vulnerabilities early instead of at audit time, and drive remediation inside federal 30/60/90-day windows for critical, high, and medium findings. Support multi-year authorizations to operate and the program's Zero Trust alignment as engineering work, not paperwork theater.

You will develop budget allocation and control algorithms that determine where to invest, how quickly to spend, and how to adjust as performance changes.

The challenge is to make reliable decisions from noisy, delayed, and incomplete signals. You will combine machine learning, optimization, and experimentation to improve incremental growth and long-term user value within budget and efficiency constraints. As Patient Referral Coordinator, you'll call patients flagged by the platform for specialist follow-up, explain in plain language why the referral matters, address questions or hesitations, and help them book their next appointment - either directly or via follow-up text, email, or voicemail. The role starts light and is expected to scale over the coming months as referral volume grows; success is measured by booking conversion rate and how quickly you respond to new referral notifications.

Follow-Up & Patient Communication

• Leave voicemails and send text/email follow-ups for patients who don't answer on the first attempt

Dashboard & Compliance

• Review overnight patient notifications each morning via the internal dashboard

• Update patient status (booked, no answer, declined, follow-up needed) using the platform's workflow tools

• Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions

المهام

• تسجيل مقطع فيديو واحد مدته من 15 إلى 20 ثانية باستخدام لهجتك العربية الأصلية.

• النظر مباشرة إلى الكاميرا طوال مدة التسجيل.

• بعد التسجيل، الإجابة عن بعض الأسئلة القصيرة عن نفسك، مثل الفئة العمرية، والدولة، واللهجة، لمساعدتنا في تنظيم مجموعة البيانات.

متطلبات التسجيل
يجب استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التالية حتى يتم قبول الفيديو:

•
جودة الفيديو: 1080p أو أعلى.

•
المدة: من 15 إلى 20 ثانية.

•
التصوير: يجب أن يظهر الرأس والكتفان، وأن يكون الوجه في منتصف الصورة وواضحًا بالكامل.

الإضاءة والخلفية: يجب أن يكون الوجه مضاءً جيدًا ومن دون ظلال قوية، مع خلفية بسيطة أو محايدة.

•
تعبيرات الوجه: طبيعية وهادئة أثناء التحدث.

•
الصوت: واضح ومن دون ضوضاء في الخلفية أو موسيقى أو صدى.

•
اتجاه التصوير: يمكن التصوير بشكل رأسي أو أفقي، مع تثبيت الكاميرا وتجنب الاهتزاز.

•
مكان التسجيل: يُفضل التسجيل في مكان داخلي هادئ.

•
غير مسموح: استخدام الفلاتر أو أوضاع التجميل، النظارات الشمسية، القبعات أو أغطية الرأس التي تحجب الوجه، أغطية الوجه، سماعات الرأس أو سماعات الأذن، العلامات المائية، الملصقات، الإطارات، أو ظهور أشخاص آخرين أو حيوانات أليفة في الفيديو.

متطلبات المشاركة

• أن يكون عمرك 18 عامًا أو أكثر.

• أن تكون متحدثًا أصليًا باللغة العربية وفقًا لتحديدك الذاتي. وقد يُطلب منك إكمال خطوة تحقق قصيرة لتأكيد لهجتك قبل اعتماد مشاركتك بشكل نهائي.

title: Electrical Technician, EagleEye
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Manufacturing Production team is responsible for a wide range of activities that are crucial to the manufacturing process including operating equipment, assembling products, performing quality control checks, and maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a strong EE repair/rework technician who can also build. In this role, you will assemble and integrate mechanical and electrical components for the EagleEye program, and when rework is needed, step in to perform PCB/PCBA/PWA repairs and cable harness rework. The EE rework work will not be continuous and will happen as needed based on production demands. If you are a highly motivated, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced team environment with minimal oversight, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Assemble EagleEye AR headset optical components, displays, and subassemblies from blueprints and schematics using hand and power tools with strong ESD practices

• Conduct product/acceptance tests and work with integrators on validation and test procedure development

• Integrate subsystems and components to ensure system compatibility while adhering to safety protocols

• Maintain detailed records of assembly processes, calibration, test results, and quality issues

• Perform rework and repair of PCB/PCBA/PWAs and cable harnesses as needed, including inspection, testing, fabrication, and root cause analysis

• Read and interpret cable assembly drawings, schematics, and test procedures using measuring devices such as oscilloscopes, ohmmeters, voltmeters, and clamp meters

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of experience working on repair and rework of PCB/PCBA/PWAs and cable harnesses/assemblies manufacturing experience in aerospace, electronics, or medical industries with strmechanical and electrical assembly skills

• Deep understanding of PCBs, PCBAs, manufacturing workflow and assembly handling, subassembly building, slderin, and calibration using tools such as calipers, micrometers, and multimeters

• Soldering, crimping, assembling cables and connectors, basic hand tools and simple tools (drill press, bandsaw, etc)

• Ability to understand written test procedures, test report, documentation of test results

• Familiarity with common termination systems and interconnect solutions from Molex, Amphenol, TE, Hirose, etc

• Basic electrical understanding (able to calculate voltage drop, size wire based on amperage, Ohm's Law, etc)

• Proficient with hand and power tools including pliers, wrenches, screwdrivers, depth micrometers, and specialized test equipment

• Strong understanding of Electrostatic Discharge best practices and adherence to safety protocols

• Understanding of fundamental electrical concepts such as Ohm's Law, voltage drop, allowable ampacity

• Familiarity with basic test equipment (DMM, Oscilloscopes, function generators)

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to rapidly adapt in a fast-paced environment

We are seeking a highly skilled, experienced, and proactive  Expert General Ledger Accountant to join our Central Accounting Team.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely execution of General Ledger accounting activities, while contributing to risk management, process efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Beyond executing accounting activities, the successful candidate will be expected to work independently, anticipate challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and actively contribute to initiatives that strengthen financial operations.

The role requires close collaboration with regional and headquarters Finance teams, Tax, Legal, Systems, and other internal stakeholders.

About the Role

 

• Accounting, Budgeting & Tax Compliance: Lead best-in-class financial processes for the Hub entity, including budget/forecast monitoring, variance reporting, annual budgeting exercises, and coordination with external tax consultants for timely tax declarations, audits, and full regulatory compliance.

• General Ledger & Financial Control: Oversee GL accounting activities across all entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to corporate policies, accounting standards, and internal controls throughout monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles.

• Audit & Internal Controls Support: Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, timely explanations, and ensuring compliance with established accounting procedures and control frameworks.

• Quality Service & Stakeholder Management: Deliver accurate, timely accounting services; proactively identify errors and process inefficiencies; implement corrective actions; maintain process documentation; and foster a service-oriented mindset with all internal stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Vision & Process Integration: Recognize and leverage the interconnection between GL and other functions (AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, FP&A) to drive process improvements and strengthen financial controls beyond transactional scope.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting requirements.

• Proven experience in financial closing, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and accounting analysis.

• Knowledge in Mexican local tax compliance.

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle Fusion.

title: Meridial – Scientist – In Vivo Neuroscience
description:
About Meridial
 
Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. 
 
Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).
 
About the role
 
Meridial is seeking a Scientist - In Vivo Neuroscience to play a central role in establishing and running our in vivo experiments.
 
This is a hands-on scientific role focused on the development and execution of advanced in vivo neuroscience experiments. You will perform complex neurosurgery, longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments in mice, and develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits. We are looking for an exceptional experimentalist who combines substantial practical expertise with scientific independence. We would also welcome candidates who combine these experimental skills with substantial expertise in neural data analysis.
 
You will report to the Director of Experimental Research and work closely with them to build the lab. You will play a central role in establishing our core surgical, imaging and optogenetic protocols and the quality standards that underpin them. As the team grows over the coming year, you will train and mentor other scientists, guide their day-to-day experimental work and help shape how the team works together. You will also work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial.

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.

Senior: Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

The team plays an important role in the broader Ray ecosystem and contributes directly to Anyscale's success.

title: Referral Specialist
description:
Zinda Law Group is an elite plaintiff’s personal injury and medical malpractice firm looking for ambitious, dynamic, driven, and passionate professionals to join our growing team. We are looking for a Referral Specialist that coordinates incoming attorney referrals and refers cases out. The specialist manages communication, documentation, follow-up, and financial tracking in collaboration with Marketing, Intake, Attorney Teams, Finance, and Referral Partners. We have offices in Texas, Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico, and Florida and serve clients throughout the nation.
We are not your typical law firm, and by joining us, you will have the following opportunities, and many, many more, at your disposal:

• Valuable, Rewarding Work: Every day, you will be helping people. Our clients come to us after they have been through one of the worst days of their lives, and the work you do here will help them get the justice they deserve and get their lives back on track. Our paralegals play a critical role in our cases and often make lifelong connections with the people we help.

• Continuous Learning: You will be mentored by and train with top professionals in your field from day one. Our in-house certifications and trainings will help you succeed no matter your level of experience.

• Obtain and save attorney-approved referral agreements, client engagement documents, and supporting records. Record approved fee arrangements and responsibilities, and escalate incomplete or inconsistent referral terms.

Outgoing referrals

• Follow up on pending placements; coordinate receiving counsel's written acceptance, attorney-approved referral terms, and required client consent.

• Draft withdrawal and transfer letters and obtain signed client agreement and consent before completing the transfer.

Ongoing case monitoring

• Obtain and save applicable documents, including signed agreements, filed petitions or complaints, settlement information, and withdrawal or closure letters. Record changes promptly and escalate missing updates or inconsistent information.

Referral relationships

• Maintain referral-partner information by state, practice area, case criteria, and availability. Build professional relationships through responsive communication, scheduled check-ins, and feedback on referral quality and service.
Records and financial reporting

Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges.
The Role
At Doppel , we’re redefining how organizations protect their identities online - and technical excellence is at the heart of everything we do. We’re looking for a Mid-Enterprise Sales Engineer located in the Pacific Time Zone to serve as the technical linchpin of our sales process: combining deep product expertise with strategic sales acumen to help customers understand, adopt, and succeed with Doppel .

• Excellent communication skills - you can translate technical language into business impact for non-technical audiences.

• Strong analytical skills for evaluating customer workflows and presenting ROI-driven recommendations.
Hands-on experience with prototyping, proofs of concept, and post-sale implementation support.

• Mission-focused, team-oriented, and customer-obsessed mindset.

Must be located in Pacific Timezone

• Certifications such as OSCP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar.

• Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN).

• Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas or successfully delivering integration projects on time and within budget.

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! We're looking for a Staff Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll define and deliver the SecOps roadmap, building the detection, response, and investigation capability that protects a fast-growing fintech. If you're excited about owning a security operations function end to end, from framework-based strategy through to the code that makes it run, then this is the opportunity for you!

- Protect sensitive data through DLP controls, and make sure the coverage matches where the data actually lives.

- Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work.

- Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution.

- Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it.

- Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction.

- Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship.

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes.

- A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI-Native R&D
description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio , our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a growing AI-native R&D team of 10+ engineers. This dual-track role combines direct people management with hands-on coding, architecture, and technical execution. You will remain close to the work, establish responsible AI-assisted development practices, and earn technical trust by helping solve the group’s most difficult engineering problems.

You will own the technical execution of complex problems from initial concept through implementation, evaluation, product validation, and production readiness. You will use AI coding agents and agentic frameworks as part of your daily workflow and help the team do the same without sacrificing code quality, security, reliability, or architectural discipline. You will turn ambiguous needs into clear, testable specifications, measurable evaluation criteria, and executable engineering backlogs, then ensure validated concepts are production-ready or transferred to product engineering through clear documentation and structured handoffs.

What You'll Do

People Leadership

• Lead and mentor the team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

• Run effective 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that help each engineer grow, thrive, and understand what success looks like.

• Set clear expectations, provide timely feedback, recognize strong contributions, and address performance or team-health concerns directly and constructively.

• Hire, onboard, and develop engineers who can operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where tools, practices, and technical assumptions evolve quickly.

• Create an inclusive, psychologically safe team environment where engineers can challenge ideas, learn from failed experiments, and make decisions with appropriate speed and rigor.

• Balance the demands of people leadership and hands-on engineering, protecting focus while staying technically credible and accessible to the team.

Technical Leadership and Hands-On Engineering

•
Own R&D initiatives end to end. Take ideas through specification, technical design, implementation, testing, evaluation, product validation, documentation, production readiness, and a structured handoff to product engineering with a high degree of independence and accountability.

•
Build with AI in the loop. Use AI coding assistants, LLM APIs, coding agents, and agentic frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable orchestration technologies to accelerate coding, review, testing, and debugging, while exercising sound judgment about when not to rely on them. End-to-end SDLC experience

Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer for the Container Services team in San Francisco. This team owns and operates Adyen's core container orchestration infrastructure, the foundation that keeps our global payment platform running. In this role, you will design, build, and operate critical infrastructure systems, drive automation and reliability improvements, and help scale Adyen's platform as we continue to grow globally.

What You'll Do

• Drive automation and reduce toil: Develop tooling and automation that improves provisioning, configuration management, and operational workflows, enabling self-service for engineering teams and reducing manual effort.

• Ensure reliability at scale: Own the availability and performance of critical platform systems, participate in on-call rotations, and drive incident response and postmortem processes that continuously improve our operational posture.
